questions.subject: MATH
questions.q: Define a finite set and give one example.
questions.a: A finite set is a set whose members can be counted and come to an end, for example {1, 2, 3, 4}.

questions.subject: MATH
questions.q: Give one example of an infinite set.
questions.a: The set of counting numbers {1, 2, 3, …} — any set that never ends is acceptable.

questions.subject: MATH
questions.q: In a class of 50 pupils, 30 study French, 25 study German and 10 study both. How many study neither?
questions.a: Study at least one = 30 + 25 − 10 = 45. Neither = 50 − 45 = 5 pupils.

questions.subject: MATH
questions.q: In a group of 45 farmers, 28 grow maize, 24 grow beans and 3 grow neither. How many grow both crops?
questions.a: At least one crop = 45 − 3 = 42. Both = 28 + 24 − 42 = 10 farmers.

questions.subject: MATH
questions.q: A die is thrown once. What is the probability of getting a number greater than 4?
questions.a: Numbers greater than 4 are 5 and 6 → 2 out of 6. P = 2/6 = 1/3.

questions.subject: MATH
questions.q: What is the probability of picking a vowel from the letters of the word MATHEMATICS?
questions.a: MATHEMATICS has 11 letters; the vowels are A, E, A, I → 4. P = 4/11.

questions.subject: MATH
questions.q: Write down the members of the set of prime numbers less than 10, and state whether it is finite or infinite.
questions.a: {2, 3, 5, 7} — it is a finite set with 4 members.

questions.subject: MATH
questions.q: If a set has 32 subsets, how many members has it?
questions.a: 2ⁿ = 32, and 2⁵ = 32, so the set has 5 members.

questions.subject: MATH
questions.q: In a class of 40 pupils, 22 like posho only, 9 like both posho and rice, and 4 like neither. How many like rice altogether?
questions.a: Pupils who like at least one = 40 − 4 = 36. Rice altogether = 36 − 22 = 14 pupils.

questions.subject: MATH
questions.q: A letter is chosen from the word UGANDA. Find the probability that it is the letter A.
questions.a: UGANDA has 6 letters and the letter A appears 3 times. P = 3/6 = 1/2.

questions.a: It ends in 0, so it is divisible by 2. Digit sum = 5+1+8+4+0 = 18, divisible by 3. Yes, it is divisible by 6.

questions.a: Parallel lines are lines in the same plane that never meet and are always the same distance apart. Skew lines are lines in different planes that never meet and are not parallel.

questions.q: Describe briefly how to construct an angle of 60°.
questions.a: Draw a straight line. Put the compass point at one end and draw an arc cutting the line. Without changing the radius, put the point where the arc cuts the line and draw another arc cutting the first. Join the end of the line to the point where the arcs cross.
